name: tinypivot
description: Data analysis studio for AI agents: turn CSV, JSON, API/MCP outputs, and SQL results into charts, pivot tables, data grids, terminal cards, and Excel exports, with a live Studio that shows every step.

interface.longDescription: TinyPivot turns CSV, TSV, JSON, API/MCP outputs and SQL results into charts, pivot tables, data grids and Excel exports. Rows stay on your computer; the model gets a short summary. A local Studio shows every step the agent takes and lets you send it messages.
defaultPrompt: Chart revenue by region from sales.csv
Pivot orders.csv by month and product
